name: Radicale
summary: Your calendar and contacts, synced to every device, from a server you own.

catalog.description: Radicale provides a small private calendar and contacts sync server for CalDAV and CardDAV clients on phones, tablets, and desktops.

features.title: Sync existing calendar apps
features.body: Use standard CalDAV clients instead of changing the app you already use on each device.

features.title: Keep personal schedules private
features.body: Store calendar and contact data in your MOS runtime instead of a large cloud provider.

features.title: Start with one private account
features.body: This package creates one htpasswd-backed Radicale user and a default calendar collection.

resourceHint.label: Light resources
resourceHint.description: Radicale runs as one small service with one persistent data volume.

privacy.summary: Radicale runs entirely on your own MOS server with no telemetry, storing calendar and contact collections in a local data volume.
notes: Use a strong app password because Radicale is exposed on its own authenticated app address.
Back up the data volume before relying on it for important calendars or contacts.
Client apps may still sync data to device or vendor backups depending on your phone or desktop settings.

homepage.name: Radicale
homepage.description: Sync calendars and contacts from your own server.

onboarding.title: Connect your calendar
onboarding.summary: Use these details with a CalDAV or CardDAV client on your phone, tablet, or desktop.

sections.title: Get started
steps: Open Radicale at its generated app URL and sign in with the username and password you entered during install.
Connect a CalDAV or CardDAV client using the Calendar URL shown below, your Radicale username, and the password you chose.

values.label: Password
values.value: Use the password you entered during install.

sections.title: Use a calendar or contacts client
sections.body: The Calendar URL is meant for CalDAV and CardDAV clients. A normal browser may show a sparse Radicale page instead of your calendar.

sections.title: Rename your calendar, don't recreate it
sections.body: You can safely rename this calendar from any connected client at any time. Avoid deleting it and creating a new one: the MOS dashboard calendar widget reads this exact calendar, and a recreated calendar no longer appears there.

choices.label: iPhone / iPad
steps: Open Settings.
Open Apps, then Calendar, then Calendar Accounts, then Add Account.
Tap Add Other Account, then Add CalDAV Account.
Paste the Calendar URL into the Server field.
Paste the Username into the User Name field.
Enter the Radicale password you chose during install.
Tap Next or Save, then open the Calendar app and confirm the account appears there.

choices.label: Android / DAVx5
steps: Install and open DAVx5. DAVx5 connects Android to private CalDAV and CardDAV servers.
Add a new account and choose Login with URL and user name, or the closest manual server setup option.
Paste the Calendar URL into the Base URL or Server URL field.
Paste the Username into the user name field.
Enter the Radicale password you chose during install.
Finish the DAVx5 setup and enable the calendar or contacts collection after DAVx5 finds it.
Open your normal calendar app, or install Etar if you want a simple open-source calendar app.

choices.label: macOS Calendar
steps: Open Calendar.
Choose Calendar, then Add Account.
Choose Add Other Account, then CalDAV Account.
Set Account Type to Manual if macOS asks how to sign in.
Paste the Calendar URL into the Server Address field.
Paste the Username into the User Name field.
Enter the Radicale password you chose during install.
Finish setup and confirm the calendar appears in Apple Calendar.

choices.label: Thunderbird / Windows
steps: Open Thunderbird and switch to Calendar.
Create a New Calendar.
Choose On the Network, then choose CalDAV if Thunderbird asks for a format.
Paste the Calendar URL into the location or server field.
Paste the Username when Thunderbird asks for it.
Enter the Radicale password you chose during install.
Choose your calendar when Thunderbird lists it, then finish setup.

choices.label: Generic CalDAV
steps: Open the account or sync settings in your calendar or contacts client.
Choose manual CalDAV or CardDAV setup.
Use the Calendar URL as the server or account address.
Use the Username shown above.
Use the Radicale password you chose during install.
Save the account, then confirm your calendar or contacts appear in the client.

sections.title: Finish when sync works
sections.body: After your calendar or contacts appear in the client, mark this guide complete.
